reports.headline: {name} Found at the Foot of the Cliffs
reports.body: {name}, who kept the hives by the well, was found at the bottom of the cliffs {dir} of the village {dist}. Those who knew {them} say {they} had no reason to be up there. A shepherd says {they} walked past him that morning, straight-backed, not answering, as if somebody were calling {them}. The edge has been roped off by nobody; people simply stopped going near it.

reports.headline: Another Fall Near the Cliffs
reports.body: For the second time this season someone has gone off the cliffs {dir} of here. {name} had complained for days of a voice from below the edge. The family asks that nobody else go looking. The children have started saying the cliff "wants company"; their parents would rather they didn't.
